bear.story: Capacity slips (YE27 ~5.75 GW vs 13 GW promised) as power equipment and funding bind; Q1-27 misses the $33-37B guide; hyperscaler supply ($1.0-1.2T 2027 capex) and customers' own builds (Anthropic 10+ GW elsewhere) push GPU rents down from mid-2027; 90-day-notice leases reprice fast; equity raise or Tesla deal at a premium; market derates to neocloud multiples (6-8x EBITDA). Fundamental value in this state ~$53 (engine bear) - price $70 allows for residual Musk premium.

base.story: 8 GW at YE27, shortage pricing (~$50/W-yr) holds through the horizon so reported numbers explode (FY27 revenue ~$168B), but by Oct-27 the market starts to price the 2028+ fade, lock-ups (Musk's ends Jun-27) add supply and net debt reaches ~$115B; the stock gives back part of its premium toward my $78 fair value.

bull.story: Musk delivers ~12-13 GW, prices hold $50+ into 2028, ARR heads toward $300B+, Starship catch and refuelling succeed; market keeps paying 15x+ NTM EBITDA (engine bull with Kilian's multiples ~$150-180, plus momentum/narrative premium).

reasoning: Skeptic lane. Facts: Q3 revenue $14.6B (SI $7.6B), 1.7 GW nameplate (+0.3 GW in Q3), Q4 capex guide $35-40B (~2x run-rate), Q1-27 revenue guide $33-37B, YE26 2.5-3 GW, Musk '13 GW' YE27 - targets raised three times in 11 weeks while the build was 0.3 GW a quarter. Bear evidence weighed: all large leases are six-month/90-day-notice (Cape Fear, Musk), so they evidence spot, not value; spreads wider than BB despite BBB ratings and S&P negative FCF to 2029; Morningstar $62, Damodaran ~$1.2T, Phillip/Chanos/Bloomberg Intelligence skeptics; short interest peaked ~34% of float; MSCI CCC governance; Clean Air Act suit live; EchoStar stock component worth ~$30B at market; Tesla deal with Musk on both sides. Weighed honestly against: rents are rising now (Nebius +17-21%, H100 1-yr +38%, CoreWeave renewals at/above prior year), Moody's sees supply behind demand through 2027, Q3 beat by 13%. So my path holds ~$52/W-yr through 2027 and fades to ~$24 (break-even ~$22) by 2031; capacity 2.45/8/12 GW YE26/27/28 (funding ~$290B in 2027 and power gear bind). Engine on Kilian's legs: EV/EBITDA 10x $114, SOTP $36 (fleet run-off has no TV, so it is worth ~2-3x its NTM EBITDA), P/E 20x $90 -> fair value $78 ($110 at Kilian's 15x/27x). Price forecast is not fair value: the fade I expect lands mostly after the horizon, so within 12 months reported growth stays spectacular; I put the 2027-10-22 median ~$118 (scenarios 70/125/245 at 35/45/20%), wide tails for 82% realised vol, P(>= today) ~30%.

model_inputs.structure_note: Kilian's SPCX legs kept: 0.4 consolidated EV/EBITDA + 0.4 SOTP + 0.2 P/E, no DCF. The SOTP carries the economics: compute as a run-off fleet by vintage at spot (internal watts at the spot rent they displace, Grok at NPV 0), a 2029-30 build window, Starlink subscriber DCF to 2036 with RONIC = WACC, Space as a Starship probability tree with knock-on to Starlink, X/Cursor at marks, SBC charged, 10% holdco discount, EchoStar and Tesla as adjustments. Consolidated FY26-28 via segment_build (FY26 = 9M reported + my Q4). Arithmetic in work_agent_3/model.py.
model_inputs.gap_note: Judgment calls for Kilian: (1) Multiples: I use 10x NTM EV/EBITDA and 20x P/E instead of the standing 15x/27x. Reason: ~85% of NTM EBITDA is GPU rental whose own SOTP treatment (6-yr life, no TV, fading price) implies the fleet is worth ~2-3x its NTM EBITDA; the only listed pure comparable (CRWV) trades ~6-7.5x 2027 EBITDA; the peer-table NTM P/E median is 19.4x and EPS peaks in 2028 in my path. At 15x/27x my fair value rises from ~$78 to ~$110 (>5%: please review). (2) Fleet path assumes the shortage ends in 2028 and price falls toward break-even ($22/W-yr) by 2031; the hold path adds ~$19/share. (3) Tesla adjustment uses market prices and a 25% premium; it is the most uncertain number in the set. (4) Net debt at horizon stated directly ($115B) because 2027 capex (~$290B) dominates the bridge.
